Jobs J1, J2, J3, and J4 all require the plant's single heat-treatment furnace during overlapping windows, so every pair among them conflicts. Jobs J5, J6, J7, and J8 all require the plant's single CNC mill bank during overlapping windows, so every pair among them also conflicts.
